claims.statement: For every uniform balanced Boolean selector whose nonconstant-frequency branch Fourier matrix has rank one, A014 factors F as a disjoint Boolean tensor sigma*g. If F is descendant-critical then sigma and g are descendant-critical and R(sigma)=R(g)=R(F); conversely equal-ratio critical factors give a critical F. If F is eta-critical then |R(sigma)-R(g)|<=eta/min(w_sigma,w_g), and factor descendants inherit eta/w criticality. Therefore no nontrivial rank-one selector product is a strict critical core.
claims.quantifiers: All finite uniform address and data cubes; genuine balanced Boolean branches; exact spectral rank one; all physical descendants; every eta>=0.
claims.units: bits for entropy; dimensionless ratios and eta
scope_exclusions: Both input claims remain pending independent review

claims.statement: For the A014 family F_t=h_t*Maj_3, any eta-criticality tolerance for t>=2 is at least [3/2/(t*2^(1-t)+3/2)]*[R(h_t)-4/3], which tends to 8/3. Thus this unbounded-read rank-one family stays a constant distance from descendant-criticality and cannot approach a strict critical endpoint.
claims.quantifiers: Every integer t>=2; uniform cube; h_t is the one-address defect sign.
scope_exclusions: Does not rule out rank>=2 overlap
